So We built the solution to our own problem. And now we're releasing it to the world. It's a macOS app for now (soon on Windows and Linux). You can invite your teammates over a local network or over the internet. They can follow your view and, if you allow them, they can also take control of your terminal and claude code/codex sessions. The app is still early, and I'm also releasing the iPhone/Android app soon to remotely control everything on your canvas. I'd would like to get feedback from the HN community! If there's any features you'd like to see, please contact me via: shyam@multipeer.sh, we build really fast. I'd love to talk to everyone of you and work on your feedback! Thanks!

projects.title: Show HN: Corgi, a helpful {agent, terminal} multiplexer
projects.author: eiopa
projects.summary: Hey everyone, Inspired by Herdr, I've built an agent multiplexer that I've been using as my daily driver for a few weeks now. I think I improved on the concept in a few ways, focusing on the ergonomics I always wished I had: I show you what the agents are up to, along with a running feed of their activity. There's also a simple shortcut (F1) to go to the next unread agent. I use multiple accounts, so I've added unified launcher for Codex/Claude Code/Pi. Theres some careful ergonomics there: fast search and resume over sessions, inline usage tracking etc. Many small quality of life improvements to the terminal experience: - Links can be copied with a click, so no need to drag-select over many lines - cmd+v just pastes images (even on SSH) - images have a thumbnail preview. - Built-in CPU/Memory/GPU usage tracking, broken down by workspace I assume you have access to cheap inference (Luna/Haiku/etc). It just reuses the agents to organize things for you: what is this http link? what is this worktree about? what is each agent doing? It's small but it made my environment feel more cozy. On a personal note, I've been on a frustrating sick leave for a while now. I created Corgi to challenge myself, and see if I can go back. The answer is more mixed than I had hoped, but I am happy with the result and thankful for the experience. I hope you like it! a few friends & myself have been using it for a few weeks and it's been pretty nice. There's still a lot to improve and some rough edges, so feedback would be greatly appreciated. Thank you :)

projects.title: Show HN: Kino Transcode – Open Red and Blackmagic Raw Files in the Browser
projects.author: lukeigel
projects.summary: I'm Luke from Kino. We make a video editor + MAM in the browser. Transcode opens Blackmagic RAW, RED R3D, ProRes, DNxHR, and MXF files in the browser (including the famously tricky OP-Atom). You can scrub rapidly, convert to H.264 or ProRes, all without installing anything or uploading footage. We built this because the film editors and creators we work with still need a desktop app just to look at a clip from these cameras, and we want it to be a link instead. The BRAW decoder builds on Paul B Mahol's FFmpeg BRAW decoder, which we ported to FFmpeg 8 and extended for newer files. For the R3D decoder, scrubbing uses quarter, eighth and sixteenth resolution, because a full 8K frame takes about 24 seconds on one core. Also, HDR clips convert to Rec.709 when they're tagged as PQ or HLG with BT.2020 colors. We also built a ProRes encoder+decoder, but we instead merged our efforts with Vanilagy of Mediabunny fame. His turbores implementation is very much worth the hype.

projects.title: Show HN: Bloom – an org-mode compatible Android app for managing notes and tasks
projects.author: rrajath
projects.summary: TL;DR: Made an android app for note-taking and task management compatible with org-mode and I'd love for you to try it. It has a ton of features and a lot of quality of life improvements. If you use Emacs and use an Android phone, this would be a great companion app for you. What is Bloom and why does it exist? Bloom is an org-mode compatible Android app for note-taking and task management. I was a long time Orgzly Revived user and there were certain pain points I wanted solved, like capture templates, bookmarks, nicer UI, better themes, handling sync conflicts, etc. I wanted to solve this for myself and spent a few months working on the app. I announced it on r/emacs ( https://www.reddit.com/r/emacs/comments/1w35r88/grove_an_and... ) a few weeks ago and it is now available on F-Droid and Play Store. Features I want to list out some of the features here (copied over from my announcement post on r/emacs): - Beautiful UI with read and edit modes that offer a really nice viewing experience (rendering headings, plain text, formatted content, tags, dates, drawers, todo keywords, etc) and easy editing with a formatting toolbar that sits above the keyboard. - Handle sync conflicts by showing a diff between current version and incoming copy and select between either of them or keep both - Capture templates that is rich with placeholders like %t, %? and even %^{prompt} - App shortcuts for easy access to capture templates - Agenda view with a separate section for overdue tasks that offers a one-click "move to today" to bulk reschedule all overdue items to today - Agenda widget with a quick add overlay to quickly add tasks - Ability to refile by drilling down to a specific heading, choose the last refiled location or use the ARCHIVE property in the heading, its ancestors or what's defined in the file-level preface. - Ability to auto archive done tasks so that your todo list is clean and you don't have to manually clean up tasks - Setting scheduled/deadline with support for repeater cookies that also have nice explanations for each (I kept forgetting them). It also supports shorthand entry like "d: fri 10-11am ++1w" - Ability to pin specific org files to the top of the list for easy access - Bookmark specific headings in the sidebar for easy access - Support for nested folders - Orgzly-compatible search expressions + visual filtering by including/excluding various facets in the UI - Ability to import/export your settings - Tons of themes. Two official Bloom Light and Dark themes, some custom themes and some popular ones like Catppuccin, Rose Pine Dawn/Moon, Tokyo Night, etc - Notifications for both tasks with a set time as well as a daily digest notification telling you how many tasks you have for the day. There are more features than what I've listed here. You'll stumble upon them as you use the app. I'd really appreciate it if you give it a try. How to get the app? - F-Droid: https://f-droid.org/packages/com.rrajath.grove - Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rrajath.gr... - GitHub Releases: https://github.com/rrajath/bloom/releases Full disclosure: LLMs were involved. But so was I. I spent a lot of time reading through the code that was generated, modifying code, tweaking things, regularly improving performance and redoing certain features over and over again so that I could get it right. One last thing. This app has no tracking, no data collection, no ads, no monetization, no paywall. I hate all of that and I don't want to put users through a shitty experience just to make a few bucks. It will forever be free. I'm very grateful for the Emacs community and it's such a joy to use emacs on a daily basis, I just wanted to share a nice (well, subjective!) app experience.

projects.title: Show HN: Ternlux – Free, local-first, bring-your-own-key AI pipeline builder
projects.author: sdataengineer
projects.summary: For the past 12 years as a data engineer, I've been building pipelines across many different business categories and sizes. Most pipelines that I’ve encountered were relatively simple jobs and required more orchestration and infrastructure than the work seems to justify. I wanted to make it easier for business users or analysts to take on the less complicated requests and technical engineers be able to focus on more complex pipelines. So in the past year I've been building a local desktop application (Mac/PC/Linux) to make it easy enough for analysts to build pipelines and answer analytical questions they have about their data, no matter their level of technical expertise. It’s called Ternlux, and it streamlines the process of transforming and getting your data where it needs to go. There are two key features: - Ask questions: AI helps to write the query for your connection and answer your question - Build reusable workflows: The AI generates SQL, Python, and workflow logic that executes based on your defined rules and triggers One of the key advantages of the application is you can perform cross-database joins between databases, local files, vector databases, and cloud storage. You describe the workflow you want and the app writes the code and builds the environment to execute it in (for local joins, it uses either JS, Python, or DuckDB to execute the code). For example, if I want to build a workflow that joins a Postgres table with a CSV file and write the results to Snowflake, I just describe the tables I want to use, the keys to join on, and where the join should run. The app takes care of the rest. I also wanted the app to be as secure as possible. It always asks for approval before performing any database or local file manipulation. It never sends anything to Ternlux servers if you haven’t opted into telemetry. It’s important to note that the app will send query results to your selected AI provider to analyze and answer your questions. It will also send the schema and a small sample size of your data to build workflows properly. It is a bring your own key application. It supports Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, and any models that are OpenAI compatible (Ollama, LM Studio, Openrouter…). All of your credentials stay encrypted locally. And the app is completely free including all features (besides the AI models you use with your own key obviously). I’ve built a quick demo showcasing the applications Demo: https://www.ternlux.com/online-demo/ 3-min overview: https://youtu.be/tA7N7wiLliA The list of connectors that exist: Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake, MongoDB, Pinecone, LanceDB, S3, GCS, Azure Blob, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, and Google Sheets. I would love your honest feedback on this. How can this product be improved? Would you currently use it as a tool to replace your current tool or in conjunction with your other tools? What feature do you find most useful and I should focus on from the list?

projects.title: 【开源自荐】token-pilot：所有 AI 工具的本地账单 + 预算控制器（国产模型自动归一）
projects.author: anthonyhann
projects.summary: 开源协议：MIT 平台：macOS / Windows（CLI 全平台） 为什么做（背景与痛点） 我同时用 Claude Code、Codex、Kimi Code，还经常通过它们跑 DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi 等国产模型。有一天发现：我根本答不上来「我这个月给 AI 烧了多少钱」——每个工具有自己的用量页，分散、单位不一、没有总账、更没有预算。 它是什么 token-pilot = 你所有 AI 工具的本地账单 + 预算控制器。 一条命令看清今天/本月各工具、各模型烧了多少 token、多少钱；菜单栏常驻 ¥今日 · 预算%；超支系统通知；打转检测（揪出死循环烧钱的会话）；省钱建议（贵模型干轻活迁移、缓存优化空间）。 几个不一样的点 国产模型自动归一：DeepSeek/GLM/Kimi/Qwen 等靠宿主日志 model 字段识别，不用单独配置；定价表对齐 8 家官方目录价（DeepSeek 含高峰/空闲分时） 覆盖 9 个数据源：CLI 日志（Claude Code/Codex/Kimi Code/pi）、SQLite（OpenCode）、zstd 压缩日志（DeepSeek Harness）、trace（WorkBuddy）、云端 API（火山 arkcli）；读不到的工具诚实标注，不假装 数据准确性可验证：自带独立对账脚本（第三方口径重算原始日志逐项比对）+ 39 个单元测试 + 36 项看板算法不变量 零入侵：只读本地日志，不装 hook、不改配置、不过代理，数据不出本机 实测数字（作者本机，2026-10） 本月 810M+ tokens · 12,685 次调用；打转检测抓到单会话 120 次重复重试；缓存命中分析显示本月缓存省了 ¥3,048；压缩潜力量化显示上下文重发还有 $63–95/月可省。 截图 安装：npm install -g token-pilot 或 Releases 下载状态栏应用安装包。

projects.summary: A fast 2 digit multiplication trick, plus six mental-math shortcuts with worked examples — and a free game to practice them.

projects.title: İbadet Rehberi: Namaz & Kıble

Home shortcuts lead to verses, duas and surahs; a digital tasbih and Hijri calendar are included. Android and iOS, free with ads. English and six other interface languages are supported. Turkish transliteration is a reading aid, not a replacement for learning Arabic pronunciation or tajweed.

projects.title: Colabio
projects.summary: Colabio connects every tracked hour to its project, task and daily update. Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, timesheets, invoices, project budgets and a read-only MCP connector so you can ask Claude or ChatGPT about your team. Visible, never hidden.

projects.title: Hardly Working
projects.summary: A free menu bar app for macOS. After the idle time you choose, it moves the cursor by one pixel so Teams and Slack don't show you as away. No clicks, open source (MIT), signed and notarized by Apple. It warns you with an alert icon if it stops working.

projects.title: The Slate
projects.summary: Never miss a movie or TV show from your favourite talent! The Slate is the unique and easy way to keep track of upcoming movie and TV projects from your favourite actors, writers, directors, or producers. Simply add them to your favourites and see their upcoming work listed in your own personal project Slate. New in v1.2: – iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS support. – Ask Siri AI to display Your Slate, add new favourites and more. – Create your own custom shortcuts with The Slate's native actions.

projects.title: Keyly
projects.summary: Keyly is a free, open-source menu bar app for macOS. Double-tap ⇪ Caps Lock, or any key you choose, to see every shortcut of the app you're in, read live from its menus. Search them, add your own in plain text, or install one of 31 templates.

projects.title: Beckon
projects.summary: Most of my day now involves AI agents: Claude Code in the terminal, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT. The slow part isn’t the models. It’s the hand-off: copying the error, switching apps, pasting, explaining which file and which project, then doing it all again for the next agent. So I built Beckon, a native Mac app. You press one shortcut in any app, and Beckon already knows what you’re looking at.

projects.title: Putzen
projects.summary: Putzen helps you to clear clutter on your Mac, one decision at a time. It's a Mac app that automatically groups duplicate files, files added over six months ago, and the rest. You can preview files, then keep or move them to Trash using buttons or arrow keys. Switch to a grid for bulk cleanup, reverse the shortcuts to suit you, and undo mistakes. Files stay on your Mac. No account, no uploads, no subscription. Try the interactive website demo before buying.

projects.title: hovernotch
projects.summary: hovernotch turns your Mac's notch into a live island. Now Playing with artwork, scrubber and synced lyrics; AirPods and battery; timers, meetings with a Join button; volume and brightness HUDs; a lock-screen player. Drag files up to the shelf, search a clipboard history that skips passwords. For developers: approve your coding agent's requests, answer its questions and review its plans from the notch. No notch? It floats. No account, no analytics, nothing uploaded.

projects.title: CareerPilot
projects.summary: CareerPilot is an AI-powered interview copilot designed to help job seekers prepare for interviews with greater confidence. It provides real-time interview assistance, resume-based answer suggestions, technical interview support, system design guidance, and live coding assistance through a Windows desktop application. CareerPilot aims to make interview preparation smarter, more efficient, and accessible to candidates looking to advance their careers.

projects.title: Copybook
projects.summary: Copybook is a menu-bar clipboard book for your Mac. Each day gets its own page so copies don’t fall into one endless pile. Notes, titled links, pictures, and named colors land as stickers; API keys and tokens stay covered until you reveal them. One payment (£4.99 / $4.99), no account, and no cloud sync.

projects.title: ExamBhai
projects.summary: ExamBhai is a free, privacy-first speed math & revision platform for competitive exams (CAT, IIT JEE, NEET, Bank PO, SSC). Turn idle study moments into 60s micro-sprints: • Vedic math shortcuts, %-fraction drills & number series • NCERT line-by-line formula flashcards & PYQ recall • Library Stealth Mode for silent reading room practice • 100% private, offline-ready local storage with zero ads

projects.title: MixBar: Volume Mixer & EQ
projects.summary: Give every app its own volume — and its own sound. MixBar is a native menu bar mixer for macOS. Every running app gets a real volume slider, its own output device and its own equalizer, so your music, meetings and browser stop fighting over one system volume. It also includes 4,000+ calibrated headphone EQ profiles. There is no audio driver to install: MixBar uses the audio taps built into macOS, and audio is never recorded or sent anywhere.

projects.title: Dots
projects.summary: Meet Dots, a customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch. Most notch apps focus on music and notifications. Dots goes further by helping you access your favorite apps, websites, and shortcuts without constantly switching windows. Watch videos while working, take scrolling screenshots, use voice commands, and more. Whether you're studying, coding, or creating, Dots adapts to your workflow. Free to get started. No subscriptions.

projects.title: Your Trusted Electrician
projects.summary: Need an electrician you can actually trust? TGS Electrical serves homeowners and businesses across Mississauga, Scarborough, and Toronto. Breaker issues? Dimming lights? Panel upgrades? EV chargers? They'll get it done right the first time. No shortcuts. No surprises. Just honest work from people who care.

projects.title: Peras
projects.summary: Peras puts a line in your Claude Code and Codex week. Set it (peras set weekly 85 pause) and once usage crosses it, the agent's next tool call is refused with a plain reason, so one long task can't burn the rest of your week. Resume whenever you want, from the terminal or the menu bar. Opt-in: your agents can be told their own usage. The CLI and hooks are free and MIT. The native Mac menu bar app is €4.99 once.

projects.title: Hourbloom: Time Tracker
projects.summary: Hourbloom is a menu bar time tracker for people who bill by the hour. Start a task in one click and watch today’s earnings grow at your hourly rate. TRACK TIME • Start, pause and switch tasks from the menu bar, where the running timer is always visible. • Projects and tasks, with an optional hourly rate for each project. • A mini timer stays on top of every window. • Left your desk with the timer running? When you’re back, Hourbloom asks what to do with that time.

projects.summary: Knovum 一款开源、本地优先的无限画布 AI 知识工作空间。将 Heptabase 式的空间白板、Obsidian 的数据掌控权（开放 JSON Canvas + SQLite）与本地离线 AI（Ollama + LanceDB + Whisper）结合，打造轻量、隐私可控的技术调研与学习桌面工作台。 • 本地优先与数据掌控：完全杜绝云端绑定和私有格式锁定。支持行业开放的 JSON Canvas 规范与标准单文件 SQLite，数据 100% 留存在本地，断网全功能可用。 • 极轻原生桌面（Tauri 2 + Rust）：底层由 Rust 驱动，前端采用 Vue 3，启动秒开，常驻内存仅几十 MB，彻底告别传统 Electron 工具动辄数百 MB 内存的笨重感。 • 空间化无限画布：支持 Markdown 笔记卡片、技术草图、PDF/音视频素材同屏混排与双向关联连线，告别死板的层级文件夹。 • 开箱即用的端侧 AI：内置嵌入式 LanceDB 向量检索与本地 Whisper 语音切片转录，原生对接本地 Ollama 模型，提供变异感知溯源引擎（修改源笔记时自动标识引文失效，避免假引用）。 • 开放协议集成：原生支持 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 与 Agent Client Protocol (ACP)。

projects.title: Mippoo
projects.summary: Mippoo is a free clipboard history manager for macOS. It sits in the menu bar and remembers the text, links, images and files you copy. Search as you type, filter by type or source app, and star favorites so they survive cleanup. Press ⌥ Space over any app to open the Quick Panel and pick an item. Your history is stored only on your Mac: no account, no cloud, no sync. Password managers and concealed items are skipped.

projects.title: Barside
projects.summary: Barside puts a note-taking app, a to-do list, a read-later inbox, a screen recorder, video meetings, a password vault and an AI assistant into one free desktop app for Windows, Mac and Linux. Your library is saved on your computer and notes work without an account. The AI uses the account you connect (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or OpenRouter), and every change it makes can be reviewed and undone. It also works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex through MCP.

projects.title: Walkcast
projects.summary: Walkcast is a free, open-source desktop app (Windows, macOS and Linux) that makes a video tour of your website from one link. A real browser signs in, visits up to 30 pages the way a first-time user would (8 by default) and returns the complete recording as an MP4 with WebVTT captions and a transcript. A voice-over is included when you add a voice key. Every caption comes from what the browser actually did.

projects.title: ApexNotch
projects.summary: ApexNotch transforms your MacBook notch into a sleek Dynamic Island command center. • 🐾 Notch Mascot Pets: Playful companions adaptive to CPU speed • 🗄️ File Shelf: Seamless drag-and-drop staging zone • 🎵 Music Visualizer: Apple Music & Spotify controls with waveforms • 📋 Smart Clipboard: Auto secret & API key redaction • 📊 11 Productivity Widgets: Pomodoro, System stats, Notes & more 100% Free & Open Source, zero telemetry, pure Swift 6 and AppKit.

projects.title: Show HN: NiFT – Frictionless, Fast, Note taking app
projects.author: t_mahmood
projects.summary: I have built a note taking, to-do application, what makes this different then others? This app targets to make note taking fun, and efficient. - Most important feature it's fast. Performance wise, and usage wise. It's a combination of convenient, clever (actually obvious) keyboard shortcuts, and focused optimizations to make it extremely simple to take notes fast. - This is completely hand crafted application, Not an AI slop, nor AI assisted. And, a lot of thought has been put to architect the app, and design. - Stores all notes in a simple text file, so personal data is never locked down. If you are a Linux user, you can simply use grep/ripgrep to filter/search your data. - Every note is one liners, actions are done through keyboard shortcuts - Local only - Organize notes using Projects, Tags - A simple but effecting Task management system - Unlimited undo/redo - Search - Filtering by date, date range - Context system to group notes and focused work - Notes are archived, instead of being deleted. But in future there will be way to purge archived notes WIP feature: Reminders - Planned features Back-links, Simple Bookmark manager, Kanban, Timer, Eisenhower matrix, while storing all data in text file. This app is still in development, and many things will be cleaned up gradually. But even in current state it's a complete powerful, efficient note taking application. [Check here for more details, and screenshots]( https://mtarin.com/projects/nift/ ) [Demo video here]( https://youtu.be/r4c6hFey-8M ) [Demo version download]( https://github.com/tmahmood/fluffy_sparrow/releases ) Let me know what do you think! NB: Previously I posted this app as FluffySparrow, NiFT uses same back-end, but the UI is completely rewritten using Tauri, with more features.

projects.title: Offstage
projects.summary: Offstage is a menu bar app that keeps the window you're using lit and lets every other window recede: dimmed, blurred or faded, in a warmth you choose. A soft spotlight follows your click. Hold ⌥ to peek. No account, no tracking. $6.99 once.

projects.title: AskOnce
projects.summary: AskOnce is a free Windows desktop app that shares project context between Claude Code and Codex. A new chat in one tool starts with a short, local, secret-scanned brief of what you did in the other, so you never explain the same project twice.

projects.title: Cybokron Dock Groups
projects.summary: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app for grouping apps and websites. Open, hide, or close a whole group in one action, and filter groups from the menu bar. Native Swift app for macOS 14+, with a universal Apple Silicon and Intel build, Developer ID signing and Apple notarization. No accounts or analytics. MIT licensed.

projects.title: Ramback
projects.summary: A Mac menu bar app that shows every simulator, emulator, Gradle daemon, container, dev server and AI agent using your RAM, and stops them the way their own tools do. Databases and pins are left alone. A Disk tab finds old runtimes and caches.Ramback shows every simulator, emulator, Gradle daemon, container and dev server eating your Mac's memory, and stops them in one click.

projects.author: UniversalSDK

github.name: UniversalSDK/Dopamine
github.description: Next-generation keep-awake utility with 0.0-nit display backlight cutoff for Apple Silicon MacBooks. Modern Amphetamine successor.

projects.summary: Dopamine 是一款专为搭载 Apple Silicon（M1/M2/M3/M4）MacBook 设计的原生 macOS 菜单栏防休眠与屏幕保护工具。 解决的核心痛点 在 MacBook 上使用传统防休眠工具（如 Amphetamine / Caffeine）时，如果合上笔记本盖子，Liquid Retina / Mini-LED 屏幕底层的背光往往依然处于通电常亮状态，不仅加速发热烘烤键盘，还严重消耗电池。 Dopamine 针对 Apple Silicon 芯片进行了深度底层优化： 1. 合盖硬件级断电：合上屏幕时，通过底层硬件接口与 DPMS 机制自动将背光彻底切断（0.0 尼特纯黑），同时保持 CPU 后台下载、大模型推理、视频渲染或编译持续运行，完全杜绝发热。 2. 开盖毫秒级复原：打开屏幕时，无缝恢复原本设置的亮度与色彩。 3. 轻量纯原生：100% Swift 原生打造，内存仅占用 ~15MB，零 Electron 臃肿。 4. 多语言适配：原生支持简体中文、英语等 11 种语言。 5. 苹果官方公证：已通过 Apple Developer ID 签名与 Apple 官方安全公证（Notarized by Apple），macOS Gatekeeper 零报警直接运行。 代码

projects.title: [开源自荐] Voltip：识别可以完全在本机的跨平台语音输入工具
projects.author: sunerpy

github.name: sunerpy/voltip
github.description: Push-to-talk voice typing for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. On-device or cloud speech recognition, AI polish with presets, a dictionary, rules and scenes, long recordings with subtitles; the phone works on its own or pairs end-to-end encrypted as the computer's microphone and keyboard.

projects.summary: Voltip 是我做的语音输入工具，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Android。在任意应用里按住 Ctrl+Alt+Space 说话，松开后文字粘贴到光标处；开着 AI 润色时，口头禅和说错又改口的部分会被去掉。识别可以用云端服务商，也可以下载 Qwen3-ASR、SenseVoice 等模型完全在本机完成；AI 润色可选，能接自己的服务商或本机的 Ollama。适合每天在电脑上写大段文字、给 AI 工具口述提示词，或不希望录音离开电脑的人。 亮点 识别可以不离开电脑：应用里能下载五个模型（Qwen3-ASR 0.6B / 1.7B、SenseVoice Small、Paraformer、实时预览用的流式模型）。Qwen3-ASR 经 transcribe.cpp 运行，有显卡时走 Vulkan（Windows、Linux）或 Metal（macOS），没有显卡就用 CPU；SenseVoice 和 Paraformer 经 sherpa-onnx 在 CPU 上运行。也可以自己配置各个服务商的URL和api key使用云服务识别润色。 词典专门对付总被听错的词：每个词条写一个正确写法和最多 10 个常被听成的样子，识别后立即替换，正确写法还会作为提示发给云端识别和 AI 润色。最后还有字面和正则两种替换规则。 场景：开始录音时看前台是哪个应用，自动换用对应的润色预设。内置了编程、办公写作、即时聊天等场景（默认关闭，打开后生效），编程场景里代码、命令、路径和标识符保持原样。 语音编辑：选中一段文字，按住 Ctrl+Alt+E 说「改得正式一点」或「翻译成英文」，选区直接被改写结果替换。 安卓手机可以当电脑的麦克风和键盘：扫码或输入 6 位验证码配对，音频端到端加密后经中继传到电脑，由电脑用自己的设置识别。 没有桌面的 Linux 服务器上可以运行 voltip-server，向本机其他程序提供 OpenAI 兼容的转写接口。 核心用 Rust 写，桌面端是 Tauri 2 + React，AGPL-3.0 开源。 目前的限制：Windows 安装包还没有代码签名，macOS 版未经 Apple 公证；iOS 版还没有；纯 Wayland 会话没有全局快捷键；不做说话人区分和批量转写。

projects.title: Notchwake

Hover it and it opens: what's playing, your next meeting, a tray you can drop files on, a timer, shortcuts, and your Claude Code sessions, where you can allow or deny a command without leaving what you're doing. projects.title: 【开源自荐】futu_algo：基于富途 OpenAPI 的港股量化交易系统，回测和模拟盘逐笔一致
projects.author: billpwchan

github.name: billpwchan/futu_algo
github.description: Futu Algorithmic Trading Solution (Python) 基於富途OpenAPI所開發量化交易程序

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源的港股量化交易系统，futualgo，基于富途 OpenAPI。 项目 2020 年写的，攒了 600 多个 star。今年翻出来一看，新装的环境根本跑不起来（futu-api 删了 OpenHKTradeContext），实盘遇到第一个卖出信号就崩，持仓平不掉，有个策略因为拿一根 K 线跟它自己比，永远不会交易。所以干脆整个重写了，刚发了 2.1.0。 现在的版本： K 线本地缓存，自动翻过富途单页 1000 根的限制，不超频率和历史额度；任意分钟周期按交易时段合成，不跨午休。 指标按通达信的算法实现，公式可以逐行搬过来；每次回测自动检查未来函数。 回测按下一根开盘价、整手成交，印花税和交易征费按成交当天适用的费率算，滑点按港交所价位表，基准是恒生指数。 模拟盘吃 OpenD 实时推送的 K 线，跟回测用同一份策略代码。测试会拿真实的一分钟 K 线同时跑回测和实盘引擎，要求每一笔成交、每一笔费用和最终资金完全一致。 自带网页控制台，不需要富途账户也能用 futu-algo web --demo 在模拟行情里体验。 Python 3.11+，Apache-2.0。

projects.title: ScreenSharePro

projects.title: Tucko

projects.title: Claude Usage Bar

projects.title: Clipket
projects.summary: Clipket is a private clipboard history for macOS that drops out of your Mac notch. • Hover the notch or press ⌃⌘Space to see recent clips, ⌘1–9 to paste instantly • Search text inside screenshots with Apple's on-device text recognition • Text expansion, colour picker, paste-in-order, smart rules • Password manager copies ignored, API keys and card numbers hidden • 8 skins, and a slim pill for Macs without a notch No account, no Clipket cloud, no analytics. One-time purchase, lifetime updates.

projects.title: [开源推荐] ScreenShade：让 AI 继续操作桌面的 Mac 屏幕遮黑工具
projects.author: zm2529

github.name: zm2529/ScreenShade
github.description: macOS display blackout with hardware brightness control and physical input wake

projects.summary: ScreenShade 是一个用 Swift/AppKit 编写的 macOS 菜单栏工具，适合让 Codex、Computer Use 等桌面自动化继续运行时遮黑本地屏幕。它覆盖多块显示器，在可读取原亮度的外接屏上尝试硬件调光，并区分物理键鼠活动与普通后台输入。支持逐屏配置硬件待机、自动唤醒验证和原亮度恢复，可作为 AppKit 窗口、IOHID 输入及 DDC/CI 控制的实践项目。 亮点 项目自荐，主要特点如下： 保留软件桌面供自动化继续使用，同时遮黑多块本地显示器，不主动修改分辨率或移动窗口。 使用 IOHID 识别物理键鼠活动，普通后台合成输入不会自动解除遮罩；另有关闭按钮及全局唤醒快捷键。 硬件待机逐屏配置，验证是可选流程：测试后自动请求唤醒、检查原亮度与桌面布局，再由用户确认实际熄屏和远程操作。未验证也能设置。 原亮度和电源状态先保存再修改，恢复失败保留记录，支持重试及重新启动后恢复。 Swift、AppKit、IOKit 实现，无第三方运行时依赖，DDC 传输部分复用 m1ddc。 主项目采用 MIT 许可证，保留第三方 m1ddc 的版权和许可声明。 使用范围：Apple Silicon Mac、macOS 13 及以上；当前需要从源码构建并授予输入监控权限，尚无经过 Apple 公证的下载版。DDC 调光、待机及远控兼容性取决于具体设备，纯黑遮罩不代表物理背光完全关闭。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Treefold：把 AI Coding 的多仓库、Worktree、终端和任务放在一起
projects.author: win5do

github.name: win5do/treefold
github.description: A local-first macOS app for running AI agents in parallel Git worktrees. Keep code, terminals, and tasks together, then merge changes back cleanly.

projects.summary: LLM 时代高强度用 AI Agent 搞项目，LLM 很强，但想要高效舒服的开发还是有很多繁琐的流程。 例如经常同时推进几个任务，还涉及前后端两个 repo，并行任务不相互冲突大家都知道用 git worktree。 手敲 git worktree 命令很繁琐，AI 可以代劳，但每次都要交代一遍却挺烦：从哪个分支创建，前后端项目在哪个目录，做完合回哪里。想去对应目录跑条命令，还得找路径、开终端、切过去。任务一多，就容易忘记哪个目录对应哪件事。 我就在想能不能把常用流程做到一个 ui 界面中管理，于是做了一个 APP 叫 Treefold。我想把每项任务的代码、终端和进度放在一起，打开就知道做到哪了，接下来可以继续做什么。 任务展开以后，要知道怎么收回来 我把工作分成三层：Project、Workspace、Fork。 Project 放一个项目相关的仓库和目录。我一般让原仓库保持在 main 分支，再为每项 feature 创建 Workspace，各自使用独立分支和 worktree。创建时默认从原仓库当前分支展开，也可以选择其他本地或远端分支作为起点。 一个 feature 里有可以并行的子任务，就继续创建 Fork。比如做“商品搜索”，可以让几个 Fork 分别负责接口、页面和测试，各自在独立目录里修改，完成后合回父 Workspace，再一起联调和交付。 这样，worktree 就有了明确的父子关系，交付时知道应该合回哪里。操作由人确认，发生冲突仍然需要处理。Workspace 还可以选择推送 feature 分支，接着走原来的远端评审流程。 简单任务开一个 Workspace 就够了，不用每次都拆 Fork。同一 Workspace 里的多个 Session 共享代码目录；需要隔离修改时，再创建 Fork。 worktree 多了，目录和状态都得看得清 git worktree list 能列出目录和分支，但想知道里面是否有未提交的修改、改动是否已经合回去，还得逐个检查。任务多了，这些小操作也会打断思路。 Treefold 把 worktree list 做成了界面里的管理列表，按仓库展开。每个 worktree 的分支、路径、当前提交和关联任务放在一起，同时显示未提交改动、冲突，以及相对目标分支领先或落后的提交数。已经合入目标分支的状态也会标出来，不用挨个进入目录查 Git。 从列表可以直接打开关联任务；不再使用的 worktree，可以在界面里确认后删除，也能清理失效的 worktree 记录。哪些还在开发、哪些改动已经合入、哪些目录可以收拾，都有地方查看。 完成的任务可以归档，先保留分支、worktree 和工作记录，之后再按需清理。Project 里可以批量清理已归档的 Workspace，Workspace 里也能清理已归档的 Fork。隔天回来看时，活跃任务和已完成的工作分开，也能找到之前的交付记录。 创建 worktree、启动 Session 和批量清理都可以在后台继续，不用一直守着弹窗。切去做其他任务后，也能回来查看状态和失败原因。 Agent 写完，检查代码和提交 我一直挺喜欢 JetBrains 的 Git 集成：修改在哪里，提交了什么，都可以直接看。 Treefold 里也放了 Git Changes 和 History。开发过程中看 diff，交付前检查提交；几个零散提交可以用 Squash 整理成一个，也可以 Reset 到指定提交。当前分支最新一次提交的说明写得不合适，也可以直接在 History 里修改。如果本地记录显示它被远端分支、标签或其他分支引用，会先提醒，再由我决定是否继续。 完成交付时，可以选择 Squash，把这项工作的成果合成一个提交放进父分支。前后端改动不一样，就分别填写提交说明，在同一个弹窗里检查后一起确认。源分支上的开发记录仍然保留，父分支收到的是整理后的提交。 我没有做完整的交互式 rebase 和冲突编辑器。常用操作放在界面里，更复杂的 Git 操作继续交给终端和 Agent，处理完再回来检查结果。 Project 里也能直接查看和搜索本地、远端分支，切换分支，或者删除不再需要的分支。这些短操作，不用每次都通过聊天交给 Agent。 检查代码时，也不想每次都重新告诉 Agent：“这是哪几个仓库，应该和哪个分支比较，别漏掉还没提交的修改。”所以加了 AI Review：在 Workspace 或 Fork 里选一个 Agent，确认提示词，就会打开一个专门检查这项工作的 Session。 Fork 和父 Workspace 比较，Workspace 和 Project 当前分支比较。Treefold 会把各仓库的路径、分支和比较范围交给 Agent，要求同时检查已提交、未提交的修改和新文件。默认提示词让它先报告问题，我确认后，可以在同一个 Session 里继续讨论、修复和验证。也可以给 Project 保存自己的 Review 提示词。 这样，从开发、检查到修复都留在同一项任务里，最后再决定怎么交付。完成交付前，如果还有将被停止的 Session 在运行，界面会先列出来，让我选择暂缓交付，或者确认停止后继续。这里检查的是进程是否还活着，不能替我判断 Agent 是否已经做完。 暂缓的任务，先记在 Todo 里 和 AI 讨论方案时，经常会冒出一些现在不做、以后值得试的点子。以前我会开个文件记 Todo，接下来还得记得这个文件放在哪。 现在可以直接记到 Workspace 的 Todo list。要做的时候，把 Todo 分配给 Fork，展开成一项独立工作；完成并合回父 Workspace 后，关联的 Todo 也会完成。 Treefold 也带了 CLI 和 Skill，Agent 能读取、添加和修改 Todo，遇到问题时也能记录阻塞原因。换一个 Session 接着做，代码、Todo 和交付记录都还留在 Workspace 里，不用依赖某一次聊天记住所有事情。 比如接口开发时发现一个值得单独处理的问题，可以先留下 Todo，继续完成手头的工作。等有空了再把它分出去，也不用为了保留这个点子一直开着原来的 Session。 Agent 把服务跑起来了，我却看不到它在干什么 调试的时候，我经常要让 Agent 启动前后端服务。以前它通常在自己的会话后台启动，再告诉我“服务已经起来了”。我只知道启动了，眼前却没有一个能持续看日志的终端。想知道请求有没有进来、服务有没有报错，还得让它再查一遍。 两个 Agent 并行工作时更麻烦：各自的会话没有共享的进程列表，不知道对方已经启动了什么。一个刚把服务跑起来，另一个又启动一遍，端口就冲突了。 Treefold 用 amux 管理这些需要持续运行的进程。服务可以跟着任务列出来，人能在界面里看日志、输入命令，Agent 也能通过 amux 查询进程、读取日志、停止或重启服务。几个 Session 可以共同观察同一个服务，启动前先查看已有进程，再决定复用还是另开一套。 切走页面不影响进程运行，也不用再回忆服务藏在哪次聊天里。不过并行启动多套服务时，端口仍然需要分别配置，Treefold 目前不会自动隔离端口。 关闭窗口时，可以选择让 App 留在后台，或者直接退出。退出 App 后是否保留 amux 和受管进程，则由单独的设置控制。 一个任务，可能要改几个仓库 有些项目的前后端是两个 Git 仓库。一个功能要两边一起改，就得告诉 AI 两边的位置，同步创建分支和 worktree，再检查是不是进了对应的目录。 所以 Treefold 的一个 Project 可以放多个仓库。创建 Workspace 或 Fork 时，相关仓库一起准备分支和 worktree，后续查看修改、同步和交付也在同一个任务里完成，各仓库的结果分别展示。 接手已有工作也不用从头开始。创建 Workspace 时，每个仓库可以分别新建分支，或者选一个已有的本地或远端分支继续做。分支列表可以搜索，已经被其他 worktree 占用的本地分支会标出来，避免选错工作目录。前端从 main 开始，后端接着已有 feature 开发，也可以放进同一个 Workspace。 还有 monorepo：一个仓库里放了很多项目，我可能只关心其中几个目录。Treefold 可以把这些子目录设为工作入口，也可以加入外部资料目录，方便 Agent 找到相关上下文。目录选择帮助组织工作，Git worktree 仍然以整个仓库为单位。 需要换回熟悉的工具时，Open With 可以直接在 IDE、终端或 Finder 中打开当前目录，也能一键复制路径。选中了哪个任务，就打开它对应的工作目录。 保留终端习惯，少记几个快捷键 我日常主要用 Agent 的 CLI 和 TUI，所以 Treefold 里的 Agent 也是原来的终端界面。目前支持 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 和 Pi，也可以单独开 Shell 跑命令。终端使用 xterm.js。 Agent 使用本机安装的 CLI，沿用自己的登录和模型配置。喜欢哪个就用哪个，同一项任务里也可以开不同的 Agent Session。使用前先确认相应 CLI 在终端里能正常运行；没有配置 Agent，也可以先用 Shell。 我喜欢 Command Palette，但不想记一大堆快捷键。所以默认只给少数高频操作绑定快捷键，其他操作从 Palette 找，也可以按自己的习惯修改绑定。 这里我比较在意上下文：在某个 Fork 里打开 Palette，新建 Session、开始 AI Review 或打开目录，就应该接着使用这个 Fork 的上下文，不用重新选一遍。 免费开源，本地运行 Treefold 免费开源，使用 AGPL-3.0-only 许可证。App 在本机运行，项目状态、任务、Session 元数据和配置保存在自己的电脑上，核心管理功能不依赖云端服务。 Agent 沿用你自己的模型和服务配置，模型调用、网络访问和费用由对应服务及配置决定。目前支持 Apple Silicon Mac，需要 macOS 14 或更新版本。

projects.title: RatePeek v1.2

Clearer window IDs, data sources and update times. 7-day trial, then optional one-time purchase. Reference values, not transaction rates. More products on Microsoft Store https://apps.microsoft.com/search/publisher?name=AdamYang&hl=en-US&gl=US

projects.title: 【软件自荐】节日彩灯 Festival Lights：给 Mac 屏幕挂一串会自动换装的彩灯
projects.author: zryfish
projects.summary: 万圣节快到了，给 Mac 屏幕也挂点南瓜和小幽灵。 我做了一个免费的 macOS 菜单栏小工具 节日彩灯 Festival Lights，在屏幕顶端挂一串会动的彩灯。万圣节挂南瓜，圣诞节换小彩灯，春节换红灯笼，给每天看着的桌面添一点节日气氛。

projects.title: IELTS Writing Simulation Engine
projects.summary: Featuring a Windows desktop app designed to provide candidates with an authentic, exam-accurate environment for IELTS Writing Task 1 and Task 2 preparation. It includes built-in Cambridge practice prompts, custom exam timers, an instant local forensic audit engine for band score estimations, and Google Gemini AI integration for professional feedback. Additionally, featuring a topic logic and vocabulary booster across mutiple subjects, live informal word replacements and PDF report exports.

projects.title: Teclo
projects.summary: Teclo sits in your Mac menu bar and plays a mechanical keyboard sound for every key you press, in any app. A keycap pet reacts as you type and powers up when you keep the pace. 10 sound packs. USD 4.99 once, for life, with a 7-day free trial.

projects.title: Umlaut Letters
projects.summary: A free one-page tool for typing German umlauts on any keyboard. Click-to-copy Ä, Ö, Ü and ß, with Alt codes for Windows, Option shortcuts for Mac, long-press instructions for mobile, plus a full Unicode and HTML code reference. No signup, no clutter. Just the characters and how to type them.

projects.title: Pin Pal - Version 3
projects.summary: Pin Pal turns your Chrome new tab into a clean, keyboard-first speed dial. Version 3 brings cross-device Google sync, Spaces to separate Work and Study contexts, Tab Stash to save entire windows, and tab snooze. Organize unlimited shortcuts into custom categories, search saved links instantly with Cmd+K or number keys 1-9, and customize your view with wallpaper blur and dim controls. Works instantly with zero account required, keeping your data private on device.

projects.title: Anki Capture
projects.summary: Select a word or phrase on your Mac, press a shortcut, and send an AI-generated card to Anki. Use your own Codex, Claude Code, or Gemini CLI and chosen model. Set explanation and interface languages separately; preview ambiguous terms. Open source. Apple Silicon/macOS 14+ preview, not Apple-notarized yet. Requires Anki, AnkiConnect, and a supported AI CLI.

projects.title: Show HN: Cute and Fun little 3D Desktop pets for Mac
projects.author: kumar_jith
projects.summary: This is a fun project i created for myself, within a span of 2-3 days. When it is fun its better to share with the world.

projects.title: ExcelConnection
projects.summary: The ultimate lightweight desktop tool to link, search, and manage your Excel sheets instantly.

projects.title: Limitly
projects.summary: Limitly: Never get caught off guard by your AI usage limits. Track Claude, Cursor, and Codex usage right from your Mac’s menu bar. Know how much you have left, when your limits reset, and get notified before you run out. 🌱 Fun, interactive themes, 🔔 Usage limit notifications, 🔑 No API keys needed, 🆓 Completely free. Built for people who build with AI. Give it a try!

projects.title: Zap
projects.summary: Zap is a tiny menu bar app for macOS that quits every open app in one click. Your windows spiral into the ⚡ button and each app quits the moment it gets there, exactly like pressing ⌘Q, so unsaved documents still ask to save. Finder, the Dock and system processes are never touched, and you can lock any app you want to keep (music, terminal…). 1 MB, no account, no network code, no tracking. Perfect before a screen share, at the end of the day or to start a focus session. 2$ one-time payment.

projects.title: Upto
projects.summary: Upto puts every app and command-line tool on your Mac in one list, whether it updates through the App Store, Sparkle, Homebrew, TestFlight, Setapp, npm, pipx, uv, or only from a download page. It checks as often as you choose, finds update sources for most apps without one, and notifies you, with a count on the Dock and menu bar. Release notes show in your language, translated on your Mac. Upto verifies every download and installs it in place, one at a time or all at once. No account needed.

projects.title: Super Shortcuts
projects.summary: Hold Caps Lock and a keyboard appears: every shortcut you've bound in the app you're in, on the key it lives on. Press it, it runs. Open an app, press keys, paste a snippet, click a button, run a script: one key each. Shortcuts know which app, site or window you're in, so one key means different things in Gmail and in your CRM. Runs on your Mac, works offline, voice transcribed on-device. For most people it replaces Raycast or Alfred. Free up to 20 shortcuts; Pro $12/month.

projects.summary: [ 10-20 新增支持了快捷键设置] [ 10-18 新增支持了 dsh 插件] 用 AI 整理内容时，我们很容易得到一份排版清楚的回答：标题、列表、对比表格，偶尔还有代码、数学公式和流程图。 但分享给别人时，往往还要做一轮整理。 一张表格复制进聊天框，可能变成夹着竖线的文字；公式露出一串符号；流程图剩下源代码。把整段内容截图发过去，阅读是方便了，对方想复制一句话、一个链接，又得借助文字识别。 我做了一个开源工具 md2chat ，中文名叫「贴贴 Markdown 」，用来处理这一步：把 Markdown 转成适合聊天的图文，普通文字保持可编辑，表格、代码、公式和流程图转成图片，再按照原文顺序组合。 ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/FaA8pV5J.jpeg) 左侧输入 Markdown ，右侧实时预览。同一份内容中的文字、表格、代码、公式和流程图，可以分别得到合适的呈现方式。 文字可以继续改，复杂排版交给图片 分享时，你可能希望临时改一下讨论时间、补上一句提醒，也希望表格和流程图保持完整。md2chat 会根据内容类型分别转换： 这种方式也有明确的取舍：代码、表格和公式成为图片后，适合阅读，但不能在聊天框里直接编辑其中的内容。如果需要对方继续修改代码或处理表格数据，可以同时附上源码或原始文档。 你可以处理自己写的 Markdown ，也可以处理从 AI 工具中复制的回答。这里不需要连接 AI 账号，也不用配置 API Key ；转换从你已经复制好的内容开始。 例如，AI 在解释一个问题时给出了数学公式，又用 Mermaid 描述了一段流程，就可以一起放进来： ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/R3pZ2W7e.jpeg) 公式与流程图完成渲染，前后的解释仍然保留为文字。图中展示的是工具内预览。 它也适合一些更日常的分享：把活动安排发给朋友，把学习笔记发给同学，或者把方案中的几段说明和一张对比表发给同事。 这些内容通常还用不上单独制作一份演示文稿，但又值得比一段纯文字更清楚一些。 不同聊天软件，采用不同的复制方式 md2chat 提供微信、钉钉、飞书、企业微信和邮件入口。选择目标平台后，工具会采用对应的转换与复制方式。 ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/BlggptlP.png) 如果每天都要做类似的事，桌面版还提供菜单栏和系统托盘入口。复制好内容后，在「剪贴板转换」中选择目标格式，转换完成后回到聊天软件粘贴即可。企微图文会打开分段面板。 你也可以把常用格式放到托盘菜单顶部，并调整顺序，减少每次寻找入口的操作。 遇到希望把整段内容作为一张图片分享的情况，桌面版还提供「转图片」入口。它会将文字、表格、代码、公式与图片按顺序合成一张 PNG 。此时整段内容里的文字也会成为图片的一部分，可以根据分享用途选择。 如果你也经常把 AI 回答、Markdown 笔记或技术说明发给别人，欢迎拿一段熟悉的内容试试 md2chat 。 https://forgeturl.github.io/md2chat

projects.title: Show HN: Frink – Desktop-first app for multi-step workflows and parallel agents
projects.author: norvalbv
projects.summary: What’s up HN?! I'm Benji, and I’ve been building Frink since ~April this year. Frink is a desktop-first, open-source (MIT) app for running coding agents in parallel and multi-step workflows that start on their own. It runs on your machine (macOS and Linux) with your own provider login. It currently supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and OpenCode, but the latter 3 are in preview. No Frink account to use the app. The biggest USP of Frink is workflows: think n8n for agents. You describe a routine in a sentence, for example: "every weekday at 9am, run the tests; if any fail, have an agent fix them, then wait for my approval before it opens a PR." Then, Frink builds it as a workflow (or simply, Flow): a list of steps you can read and change before it runs. A Flow can start on a schedule, from any webhook, or from an event from a third-party such as Linear, Shortcut, ClickUp, Sentry, PostHog, etc. Steps can be agent turns, shell commands, conditions, approval steps that stop and wait for you, or steps you write yourself in code (or ask the agent to write one). Everything that needs you (an approval, an agent's question, a finished task to review) lands in one Work Queue. Other stuff: * Up to four agents side by side, each on its own git worktree if you want. Or, many agents out of direct view. * Every change shows as a diff; there's a code editor, a terminal, etc. * Local-first: chats, Flows and tasks live in SQLite on your machine. * Easier provider parity: currently working on and improving the tooling setup between providers. Once inside Frink, irrespective of what provider you use, the hooks, MCPs, and other tooling work out of the box between providers. Why I built it: I started building it when there weren’t many other competitors; now the industry is swamped with ADEs and harnesses. However, in my opinion, each still lacks good automation for more fine-tuned scenarios. I doubled down on the flows to help me with my actual day-to-day job as a SWE, and over time it’s helped me automate most of the PRs being shipped across my personal projects, team, etc., to the point that it’s a continuous loop and helps a whole ton. Notes: Windows isn't supported yet. Flows only run on Claude Code and Codex for now. It's a solo project, so expect sharp edges.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】iPhone Agent Harness：用 Safari + ESP32 让 AI 无线操作 iPhone
projects.author: cccat6

github.name: cccat6/iphone-agent-harness
github.description: Automate your iPhone from Safari with a low-cost ESP32 Bluetooth bridge. Local conversations, your choice of AI, and community skills.

projects.summary: 中文说明： 大家好，我是项目作者，想自荐一个开源的 iPhone 自动化项目：在 Safari 中用自然语言描述任务，由智能体查看屏幕，再通过旁边的 ESP32 蓝牙桥完成点按、输入和滑动。网站提供了在真实 iPhone 上设置闹钟的演示。 实现方式 Safari 负责会话、屏幕采集和模型调用；Harness 校验动作计划后，通过局域网 WebRTC 发送指令。 ESP32 模拟蓝牙鼠标和键盘，通过 iOS 辅助触控操作手机，不在板上运行大模型。 手机和桥接板使用同一个日常 Wi-Fi，板子独立供电，手机不用插线连接板子。 首次固件安装可在电脑 Chrome / Edge 中完成；提供会话管理、自选模型、可分享技能和 MCP 工具配置。 会话、截图和密钥保存在当前浏览器；选定的上下文发送给用户选择的模型服务商。项目提供英语、简体中文、繁体中文、日语、俄语、德语、法语和西班牙语版本。 当前需要 iOS / iPadOS 27+、Safari 屏幕共享、辅助触控，以及可用的视觉模型。演示是具体任务的实机结果，不代表任意 App 或长流程都已验证。 项目受到 onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent 的启发，已在 README 中致谢。我们的实现采用 Safari + 蓝牙 HID 的无线使用路线。 欢迎试用、反馈设备兼容性和希望自动化的手机任务。

projects.title: AirControl

projects.title: Ahed
projects.summary: Vibe coding, made easier. Ahed turns your project context and personal preferences into useful next prompts, magical ghost text, and shortcuts that keep you building.

projects.title: Praex
projects.summary: Praex is an AI coding agent that runs on its own model family: Velox II (free, fast), Faber II (Pro, deep reasoning) and Lucia II (frontier, coming soon), post-trained from the best open models. It reads your repo, edits with your approval, runs your tests and explains every change. Use it in the terminal, the desktop app or the browser, and continue any session from your phone with /rc. The terminal agent is open source (MIT). Free to start, Pro $20/month.

projects.title:
为了不让闲置的备案被管局注销,索性单搓了个 macOS 侧边栏笔记： iFolo Note
, macOS 侧边栏简约笔记
projects.author: Jensond
projects.summary: 前阵子让 muse 整理云资产，发现早年藏箱子底的项目 `https://www.ifolo.cn` 和辛苦拿下的 ICP 备案号一直在吃灰,还有 claude 的 tokens,索性拯救了一下尸山代码,搓了一个 macOS 侧边栏笔记：iFolo Note.按我自己使用习惯来的,大家可酌情使用,可提提意见!免费,免费,免费! ### 为什么要造这个轮子？ 每天面对 IDE 和 多 Agent 终端，我在 Mac 上随手记东西一直很割裂： * **重型软件太重**：只是想临时贴段 JSON 、记行命令或闪念，用 Notion 、Obsidian 甚至系统备忘录都得 `Cmd + Tab` 切窗口，打断思路。 * **桌面便签太乱**：贴多了像牛皮癣，过后根本找不到。 我想要的只是一个**平时完全隐形、需要时从屏幕边缘一秒滑出、写完立刻缩回去,AI 时代还支持可控 mcp**的轻量容器。 ### 核心特点 1. **无感边缘呼出**：常驻屏幕侧边，鼠标贴边或快捷键秒开。全屏写代码、开会时随叫随到，不抢焦点，用完即走。 2. **原生丝滑体验**：拒绝套壳卡顿，深度优化了滑出帧率与输入延迟，后台常驻几乎零感。 3. **Markdown 混排直出**：代码片段、Todo 、临时链接所见即所得，无需在源码和预览模式间反复横跳。 4. **不只是临时草稿**：支持双链与标签整理，纯本地 Markdown 存储,目前还没做云端同步、s 5. 3 同步啥的，Mac 侧边栏记下的碎片灵感，随时能在 iOS 端继续整理，数据完全自主。 --- ![1792413680626.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad60ff81f2e3.webp) ![1792413938920.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad61104628ca.webp) ![1792413857126.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad611192ceb9.webp) ![1792413927750.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad611198bb42.webp) ![1792413912991.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad61119879aa.webp) 目前 Macos 端已稳定,后期计划 windows 端，欢迎大家体验,免费、免费!： 👉 **官网**： https://www.ifolo.cn

projects.title: Accent Letters for Chrome
projects.summary: Typing é in a browser means leaving whatever you were doing — a search, a copy-paste site, Character Map. Accent Letters is a free Chrome extension. 682 accented letters in your toolbar, A to Z, each with its Alt code, keyboard shortcut and HTML entity. Click one and it is on your clipboard. Search by the letter itself, by its Unicode name, by language, or in plain words: "two dots", "squiggle", "hat". Works in Brave, Arc and Opera too. No account, no ads, no tracking.

projects.title: PickDock
projects.summary: PickDock puts Android apps, web links and map links into tabs you organize. Search and sort your links, adjust display size and layout, and open a tab through a home widget or shortcut. Backup and restore includes a review of differences before restoring, while missing app entries are retained. Build separate spaces for the links you use during different parts of your day. Android only.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】兰桥：带 AI 修电脑助手的远程桌面，动手前先征得你同意（提供免费版）
projects.author: JackieDD
projects.summary: 兰桥是我们做的一款远程桌面工具 在要被控制的电脑上装好客户端，另一台设备打开浏览器网页版，就能远程操作那台电脑，控制端不用安装。 和普通远程桌面不同的是，它内置了一个 AI 助手“小兰”。远程连上之后，遇到“软件打不开”“系统更新卡住”“磁盘空间不足”这类问题，可以先让小兰查原因，它会把检查结果和下一步办法讲清楚，需要动手修改时会先停下来，等你确认。 主要特点： 1. 提供免费版：同一账号可绑定多台电脑，同时控制 1 台；公网画面最高 1920 像素宽、30 帧，原生客户端在局域网内可选 4K/30 帧（实际效果受硬件和网络影响）；支持文件传输；在线 AI 有每 7 天滚动计算的免费额度。 2. 连接需要输入验证码或由对方批准，随时可以断开。会话使用 AES-256-GCM 加密，中继服务器只转发密文。 3. 小兰有三档权限：逐步确认（编辑外部文件、使用互联网时都会询问）、仅高风险确认、完全访问（仍限本次任务已确认的应用、文件和网络范围）。 4. 支持微信、手机号登录，国内有备案站点；Windows 安装包已签名。 定价与免费额度： 隐私政策： 目前被控端支持 Windows 10 及以上（x64）和 macOS 14 及以上（仅 Apple 芯片），暂不支持远程开机。 我们最初是为了“帮爸妈远程修电脑”这个场景做的，早期用户反馈还不错，欢迎试用和提意见。

projects.title: QuickTriggers: Text Expander
projects.summary: Type less. Save time. QuickTriggers is a powerful productivity tool designed to help you save frequently used text, images, PDFs, files, and links as quick shortcuts (Triggers). Stop typing the same information repeatedly or digging through your storage for that one file - create a short trigger and let QuickTriggers expand or share instantly! Whether you manage email templates, documents, files or standard replies, QuickTriggers makes everyday communication effortlessly easy.

projects.title: VibeRes
projects.summary: VibeRes is a free, open-source resolution switcher for the macOS menu bar. Every connected display and all its scaled and native modes are one click away. Hover a mode to see how much bigger or smaller the screen gets before you switch. Save multi-display profiles like Work, Code or Presentation and run them from Shortcuts, Siri or the viberes CLI. Native SwiftUI, signed and notarized, installs with Homebrew. A successor to EasyRes, which is no longer maintained.

projects.title: OpusBar
projects.summary: OpusBar is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app for Claude Code and Codex. A pixel cat shows your most urgent session, and a badge counts the ones waiting on you. It tracks 5-hour and weekly limits and what your tokens would cost. Nothing leaves your Mac.

projects.title: LazyBoard
projects.summary: Save the replies, signatures and prompts you type every day, then insert them with a short shortcut likethanks. Fill in names and dates before inserting. Works on Mac, Windows and Chrome. Free for 10 snippets, no account needed.

projects.title: 【产品自荐】Netlink：Mac 出口 IP 一变就提醒，一键体检 VPN、代理和 DNS
projects.author: venshine
projects.summary: Netlink 是一款 Mac 菜单栏 App，后台盯着出口 IP，一变就通知；一键沿八个阶段检查 VPN、代理、DNS 和时区，给出评分和每项扣分的修复建议。查询使用内置数据库，联网前先征得同意，运行在沙盒中。免费使用，Pro 一次买断。

projects.title: StampIt
projects.summary: A lightning-fast, 100% offline desktop app that lets you batch-watermark your photo collections instantly with zero subscriptions, zero cloud uploads, and...

projects.title: [开源推荐]NotchMuse：在 Mac 菜单栏和刘海旁显示同步歌词
projects.author: Xiye88

github.name: Xiye88/NotchMuse
github.description: NotchMuse v0.8.0: synced macOS lyrics for Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase, QQ Music and Soda Music. Menu bar, notch, side and Dock lyrics with in-app updates.

projects.summary: NotchMuse 是一款用 Swift 和 AppKit 编写的原生 macOS 歌词工具，MIT 协议开源、免费使用。它能自动识别当前播放的 Spotify、Apple Music、网易云音乐、QQ 音乐或汽水音乐，把逐行同步的歌词显示在菜单栏、MacBook 刘海旁、屏幕左右两侧或 Dock 上方。写代码、看文档时不必切回播放器窗口，也能随时看到当前这句歌词。 亮点 1. 国内播放器也能用：除了 Spotify 和 Apple Music，还支持网易云音乐、QQ 音乐和汽水音乐。这三个播放器通过随应用打包的 MediaRemote bridge 读取播放状态，不用装 Homebrew，也不用额外装 helper。同类工具 LyricsX 主要面向 iTunes/Spotify/Vox，最近一次 release 是 2022 年。 2. 四种显示位置：菜单栏、刘海旁、屏幕左右两侧、Dock 上方，宽度和位置都能调，正好利用 MacBook 刘海两边原本空着的区域。 3. 原生、轻量：用 Swift + AppKit 编写，不是 Electron。DMG 大约 6.8 MB，支持纯色/渐变、背景、透明度、外观预设，跟随系统浅色/深色。 4. 自动检测播放器：同时开着几个播放器时，会自动跟随正在播放的那个，也可以手动指定。 5. 隐私：不用注册账号，App 内没有遥测；只把歌名、歌手、专辑、时长发给歌词源做匹配，不上传音频。 6. 开源：MIT 协议，第三方组件见 THIRDPARTYNOTICES.md；README 有中英文两份，另有 CHANGELOG 和发布说明。

projects.title: LaunchAsset AI
projects.summary: LaunchAsset AI is a lightweight, offline Windows desktop utility for indie hackers, founders, and developers. Skip complex design tools and subscription software—generate high-resolution Product Hunt banners, Twitter headers, and social preview cards directly on your PC with zero cloud dependency.

projects.title: Show HN: An outliner to replace Workflowy and Obsidian – as a Claude connector
projects.author: laurentenhoor
projects.summary: A free outliner with Workflowy's shortcuts and Obsidian's markdown, no backend, and a Claude connector built in. Say "add that to my notes" in any conversation and it lands in your outline; ask what you wrote last month and Claude answers from it. No account to try: bulletlist.org/demo

projects.title: Rowcraft
projects.summary: Rowcraft is an open source database workbench written in pure Rust. Write SQL, explore schemas, and browse data in a fast native desktop app, with no Electron and no JVM. It has a CLI from day one, and it's built to cover the same ground as heavyweight IDEs like DataGrip while staying lightweight and free.

projects.title: Look Launcher
projects.summary: Look is a free, open-source launcher for macOS, Windows and Linux, with every feature free. Find apps, files, folders, clipboard history and open windows as fast as you type. One-key system controls (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, media, keep-awake) work on GNOME, KDE and tiling WMs alike. Rust core, no browser engine, no telemetry, no account. Install from Homebrew, AUR, nixpkgs or Scoop, or grab the installer from GitHub Releases.

projects.title: snyvi
projects.summary: snyvi is a free, open-source desktop app for people building several passion projects at once with coding agents. Each project gets a desk: its folder, up to four agents side by side (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, any shell), and its own notes. Every plan or review an agent writes lands on that desk as a clean page, versioned. Home shows where each project was left. Local only, no account, MIT. Mac tester needed: the Mac build is signed and notarized, but we don't own a Mac. Try it and tell us.

projects.title: MacMetric
projects.summary: A private, native menu bar monitor for people who run dev servers, containers and local AI. Groups helper processes under their app, maps ports to projects, keeps 30 days of history, and never sends your data anywhere. 14-day free trial.

projects.title: inlaut
projects.summary: inlaut is a menu bar dictation app for the Mac. Hold a shortcut or the 🌐 key, speak, let go, and the text is pasted into whatever app you are in. Recognition runs entirely on your Mac, on the Neural Engine (NVIDIA Parakeet as Core ML), so it works offline and nothing is recorded or sent anywhere. It handles English, German and sentences that mix both. No account, no subscription. Free and open source (GPL-3.0). Needs Apple silicon and macOS 26.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】CoWork OS：执行前都由你批准的开源 AI 桌面应用
projects.author: AlmarionAI

github.name: CoWork-OS/CoWork-OS
github.description: Rent the model. Own everything else. Free, open-source AI app for real work.

projects.summary: CoWork OS 是我们开发的一款开源 AI 桌面应用（MIT 协议，支持 macOS 和 Windows）。它可以处理文件、文档表格和演示文稿，操作浏览器，整理邮件和日历，运行定时任务和聊天机器人。 和命令行智能体相比，它的重点是“看得见、管得住”：每一次工具调用都实时显示在任务时间线上；发送消息、联网、使用凭据、读写工作区以外的文件之前，都会弹出批准卡片，显示将要执行的完整命令，由你确认后才运行。 模型可以自己选：本地 Ollama、LM Studio，或 OpenRouter、Kimi、GLM、ChatGPT 账号等。首次任务可以通过 OpenRouter 的免费模型直接运行，不需要 API key。记忆以 Markdown 文件保存在本地 git 文件夹里，每次修改都是一次提交，可以直接打开查看和编辑。 最新的 0.5.61 版本还支持从 Hermes Agent 和 OpenClaw 一键迁移人设、记忆、技能和定时任务，导入前会先列出所有内容，不会修改原来的目录。 安装只需要一条命令，不会弹出系统安全拦截： macOS（Apple 芯片）：curl -fsSL | bash Windows（PowerShell）：irm | iex 其他系统 / Intel Mac：npm install -g cowork-os 应用界面目前是英文的，中文说明见 README.zh-CN。

projects.title: Snap2Paste
projects.summary: Snap2Paste is a privacy-first Chrome extension that captures the visible area or a full webpage and copies it straight to your clipboard—ready to paste into ChatGPT and other AI chats. You can also export captures as PNG or PDF.

projects.summary: Hold a key, speak, release — AI-polished text appears at your cursor in any app. Open-source voice input for macOS & Windows. (按住快捷键说话，松开即得润色后的文字)

projects.title: [开源推荐] Folkbench：AI 中转站实测榜单与一键切换客户端
projects.author: realMatthewhsu

github.name: Folkbench/folkbench
github.description: AI API 中转站评测排行与切换工具：实测可用率、延迟与价格 · Open-source AI API relay benchmark, rankings & switcher for Claude Code / Codex

projects.summary: Folkbench 是一个开源的 AI API 中转站评测与切换工具。官网 folkbench.com 持续实测各家中转站的可用率、响应延迟和价格并公开排行；配套的桌面客户端 Folkbench Switch（Tauri + Rust）可以在多个中转站和官方线路之间一键切换 Base URL 与 API Key，自动写入 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等工具的配置，不用再手动改配置文件。 亮点 公开实测数据：成功率、响应速度、价格和数据安全等级一张榜单看清，还有单模型排行 一键切换：Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等编程助手配置一键写入，对新手友好 跨平台桌面端：基于 Tauri + Rust，支持 macOS（Apple Silicon / Intel）和 Windows，安装包附 SHA256 校验 客户端代码 Apache-2.0 开源，README 支持中、英、日、西四种

projects.title: QuotaPanel：基于 Wails 的 AI 订阅额度管理工具
projects.author: ModStart
projects.summary: # 引言 在 AI 开发日益普及的今天，开发者需要同时管理 Claude 、ChatGPT 、GitHub Copilot 、Kimi 等多个平台的订阅与 API 额度。这些额度信息分散在各个控制台，难以快速掌握整体使用情况。 **QuotaPanel** 是一款开源的桌面端 AI 额度管理工具，基于 **Go + Wails + Vue3** 技术栈开发，支持 16 种 AI 订阅与 API 额度来源，本地优先保护隐私，跨平台支持 macOS/Windows/Linux 。 ![]( https://open-cdn.tecmz.com/theme/apps/quotapanel/images/account.png?t=202609261508) ## 核心特性 ### 本地优先设计 QuotaPanel 采用**本地优先**架构，所有账号密钥与浏览器会话数据均保存在本机（默认 `~/.quotapanel/`），不会上传到云端。数据目录支持通过 `QUOTAPANEL_DATA_ROOT` 环境变量自定义位置。 ### 多源额度聚合 工具支持 16 种 AI 订阅与 API 额度来源，分为两大类： **浏览器登录类**： - Claude 订阅（ 5 小时及每周额度） - ChatGPT/Codex （订阅使用窗口） - Cursor （当前周期用量） - Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan （套餐积分与账户余额） **API Key 类**： - GitHub Copilot （ Premium 、聊天与补全额度） - Z.ai Coding Plan 、Kimi Coding Plan 、MiniMax Token Plan - Devin/Windsurf 、Grok CLI 、OpenCode - Command Goat 、DeepSeek API 、Kimi API - OpenRouter 、OpenAI API ### 额度可视化 通过进度条、余额明细、账期/重置时间等可视化元素，系统提供正常、即将用尽、超限三档状态色，超出阈值时会主动提示。 ![]( https://open-cdn.tecmz.com/theme/apps/quotapanel/images/account-dark.png?t=202609261508) ## 技术架构 ### 技术栈 - **Go 1.24+**：后端核心逻辑与额度查询服务 - **Wails v2**：跨平台桌面应用框架 - **Vue3 + TypeScript**：前端界面开发 - **AntDesign Vue**：UI 组件库 - **TailwindCSS**：样式框架 - **SQLite**：本地数据存储 ### 项目结构 ``` quotapanel/ ├── main.go # Wails 应用配置与入口 ├── app*.go # App 暴露给前端的方法 ├── backend/ │ ├── base/ # 基础库（数据库、配置、日志、窗口、平台差异等） │ └── quota/ # 各额度供应商适配器与查询服务 ├── frontend/ │ └── packages/ │ ├── ui/ # 主界面（ Vue3 + AntDesignVue + TailwindCSS ） │ └── quota/ # 额度业务模块 ├── demo/image/ # 界面截图 ├── docs/ # 文档（额度来源调研等） └── Makefile # 开发、构建与发布命令 ``` ### 开发环境 - Go 1.24+ - Wails v2 - Node.js 20 + pnpm ```bash # 安装 Wails CLI go install github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails@latest # 安装 pnpm npm install -g pnpm ``` ### 开发命令 ```bash # 安装依赖 make install # 启动开发模式（前端热重载） make dev # 构建生产版本 make build # 构建并安装到 /Applications （ macOS ） make build-install ``` 修改 Go 暴露给前端的方法后，执行 `wails generate module` 重新生成 JS 绑定。 ![]( https://open-cdn.tecmz.com/theme/apps/quotapanel/images/account-card.png?t=202609261508) ## 功能亮点 ### 新增账号管理 支持选择来源并填写 API Key 或发起浏览器登录，可自定义账号名称与备注，密钥默认脱敏展示并支持一键复制。 ### 浏览器登录 需要网页登录的订阅（ Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor ）通过独立 Chrome/Edge 窗口登录，登录会话持久保存，删除账号时一并清理其浏览器资料。 ### 卡片截图 一键将单张订阅卡片导出为 PNG ，方便分享或记录。 ### 定时刷新 默认每 5 分钟自动轮询一次，额度变化实时可见。同时也支持随时手动刷新单个或全部账号。 ### 托盘常驻 macOS 菜单栏/Windows 、Linux 系统托盘，快捷显示、重启、退出。关闭窗口行为可配置为「每次询问/直接退出/隐藏到后台」。 ### 多语言支持 简体中文/English 切换，界面与后端文档页配色集中到设计 token 管理，支持浅色/深色两套取值。 ![]( https://open-cdn.tecmz.com/theme/apps/quotapanel/images/setting.png?t=202609261508) ## 总结 QuotaPanel 是一款功能完善、设计优雅的 AI 订阅额度管理工具，采用 **Go + Wails + Vue3** 技术栈，支持 16 种 AI 订阅与 API 额度来源。 **核心优势**： - ✅ **开源免费**：采用 Apache-2.0 许可证，可自由使用、修改和商用 - ✅ **跨平台支持**：macOS 、Windows 、Linux 全覆盖 - ✅ **隐私保护**：所有数据本地存储，不上传云端 - ✅ **持续更新**：社区活跃，支持新增额度来源 **适用人群**： - AI 重度用户，需要管理多个平台的订阅额度 - 开发者，希望参与开源项目或自定义额度来源 - 技术爱好者，对 Go/Wails/Vue3 技术栈感兴趣 如果你也是 AI 重度用户，或者需要管理多个平台的订阅额度，不妨试试 QuotaPanel 。让它成为你开发工作流中不可或缺的一部分。 > ⭐ 如果这个项目对你有帮助，请在 [GitHub]( https://github.com/open-tecmz/quotapanel) / [Gitee]( https://gitee.com/open-tecmz/quotapanel) 上点亮 Star 支持开发者！

projects.title: Show HN: Rouler – Steer Windows traffic per app or IP across multiple interfaces
projects.author: brndnbuilds
projects.summary: Hi HN, Rouler is "rules for your routes". It allows you to steer network traffic across multiple network interfaces on Windows. For example: - Run Tailscale, Mullvad and OpenVPN official clients simultaneously. - Use Rouler to send Slack via the OpenVPN connection, Chrome + an IP range via Tailscale and a torrent client via Mullvad. Rouler is VPN agnostic, so you can "split-tunnel" with anything that sets up a windows network interface. I'm an independent developer from Australia and have been working on Rouler for a bit over a year. It's been a challenging project to say the least, but I'm really happy with how it's turning out. I have spent a great deal of time building and throwing things away, starting over, belting the initial poc into something that I find intuitive... hopefully others do too! I've done all the testing, fixing and improving I can, so now it's open for public beta. I'd love to hear your feedback... and there are some specific points I'm interested in hearing about listed on the Rouler website. Please reply with any questions you might have. Thanks for reading! Brendan p.s. Rouler is "built in Rust" TM ;-) --- On AI (skip if you're sick of hearing about it): Since AI is the hot topic and people are naturally cautious about it, I'll add some quick notes about it, specifically about the driver development as that's the key thing to get right. The driver is hand written and every detail has been poured over many times over. I spent somewhere around 6-9 months manually building and testing just the driver, staring at Dbgview logs, wireshark logs, windows route tables, restarting VM's back to their snapshot and manually copying things across to start again. That's not always the most efficient way of doing things, but it's the way it had to be done. If I had tried to vibe code it Rouler simply wouldn't exist. I did try to lean on AI at times, but it constantly sent me in the wrong direction, told me things weren't possible, tried to take shortcuts and implement poor performing trade-offs. It also loved to hallucinate the windows api. Keep in mind this was around the Opus 4.1 - 4.6 days. Outside of the driver, in user mode land, AI has crept more and more into my workflow. I've had a lot of success utilising the latest models in the app in particular, and I purposefully separated the UI and core logic so I'm able to quickly iterate on the UI. I've also found AI very useful for scripting and refactoring. It has built some great scripts that would've taken me days or weeks to build and fine tune.

projects.title: Show HN: Chest – a tiny, open-source menu bar manager for macOS 27
projects.author: a-ve
projects.summary: Hi HN! One of my favorite apps on macOS, Ice, stopped working when I updated to macOS 27 because the trick it relied on doesn't work anymore. The only thing I really needed from the app was the ability to hide menu bar items to the left of it, so I built Chest to do just that. There are other apps like this as well that try to use the menu bar part of macOS's exam mode to hide items, but that approach has some issues with the screen sharing, microphone, and camera indicators in the menu bar, which is rather troublesome for me. Chest works by emulating the "Allow in the Menu Bar" switches in System Settings rather than relying on the old trick of pushing menu bar items off-screen. It just needs Accessibility permission and access to two files that let it control which items are shown in the menu bar and where they're placed. You can hide items in two ways: by ⌘-dragging them to the left of a small dot in the menu bar, or by dropping them into a separate "Chest" that keeps them out of the menu bar entirely. Clicking the dot brings the hidden items back. I think our approach is rather cleaner, and the app itself sits at ~2 MB, so it's small enough to not matter while providing a clutter-free menu bar. You can view the source at https://github.com/boringbar/chest

projects.title: # 【開源自薦】13歲香港初中生，不看任何開源源碼，和 DeepSeek 從零手擼了一個非 Vibe Coding 的 64 位裸機 UEFI 操作系統：NeuroSamaOS
projects.author: Andrew-T-Davis
projects.summary: 大家好，我是來自香港的 13 歲初中生 NeuroSamaOS 是我和 DeepSeek 共同開發的 UEFI 操作系統（其中 DeepSeek 主要參與硬體規範文檔的翻譯與實現步驟的講解）它受到 TempleOS 啟發，但不基於任何現有內核，不看任何其他開源倉庫的代碼來開發這個項目，並且不是 TempleOS 的 Fork 這是一個裸機系統（废话，我标题都说过了），不喜欢盲目 Vibe Coding（第一我没Token（从来没充过），第二我是老一派的），完全由我閱讀规范他妈的一行一行地写出來，可以直接在實體機 CPU 上運行！（我跑了实体机一分钟，没崩，所有都正常，然后我关机继续开发NeuroSamaOS了） 代碼倉庫： 項目官網： 詳細討論 (OSDev Forum)： 下載體驗： 直接 git clone 倉庫是最好的選擇 目前已實現的功能 1. 內核架構與內存管理 Ring0：全系統運行在最高權限 Identical Mapping & La57：等同映射與現代 5 級分頁支持 KMalloc：內核級內存分配 Task：多任務調度 2. 中斷、高級控制與多核 I/O APIC & ACPI SIPI / IPI / INIT：實現多核初始化與處理器間中斷 MSI & INTx & MSI-X：現代中斷機制支持 CISC Instruction Length Parser：在 IDT 中實現的 CISC 指令長度解析器 3. 儲存與文件系統 SATA & AHCI 驅動 FDFD （FREEDOM DiSK[FOUR DIMENSIONS]，玩过OSU的都懂，XD,我爆发最高手速是270BPM(1/2)BTW） 硬盘格式 4. 輸入輸出與多媒體 GOP（圖形輸出協議）& WM（窗口管理器） GUI：已實現圖形界面（註：在我看來目前有點醜我追求美感而非單調，就像乔布斯那樣，後續會持續改進） HDAudio & AC97 & WAV & AMP：支持聲卡驅動與音訊播放 PS/2 鍵盤與滑鼠驅動 5. 現代 CPU 指令集優化 REP MOVS/STOS AVX256 & SSE1~SSE4.2 NT (Non-Temporal) 緩存優化與 FPU 支持 6. 內置 JIT 編譯語言 JIT 核心 通用AST引擎（我敢说这是我在我的生涯中弄过最牛逼的，没有之一，妈的） 7. 还在开发中的 HolyNeuro-JIT GPT 分區表支援 FAT32 & RedSea 文件系統支援 xHCI 驅動以及 xHCI 鍵盤 & 鼠標 支持 （这玩意儿是真难搞吧，我太多东西依赖PS/2了，等多我一个月！！！！！，我只差中断和设备PORT一直运作的逻辑就OK了） 開發狀態與後續計劃 考慮中的： E1000 / E1000E 乙太網路卡驅動 IwlWiFi 無線網路卡驅動 C99-JIT（將 C 語言從傳統的 AOT 改造成運行時 JIT 編譯執行） HolyC-JIT （这个要等HolyNeuro-JIT开发完才可以开始根据功能移植HolyC-JIT） 基於信仰原因在这个项目不能被加入的（我在其他项目可以，XD）（但歡迎大家 Fork 自行加入）： Ring3 用戶態 Non-Identical Mapping（非等同映射，也就是类似Linux和Windows的0xFFF800000000那套非常复杂的东西，因为我坚持不搞复杂所以这复杂玩意儿我没加） 已拋棄且不需要單獨寫的功能： eHCI & oHCI & uHCI（因為這三个早就他妈被Intel集成並兼容於 xHCI 中了） 我今年 13 歲，來自香港，我的信仰是 Terry A. Davis 和 TempleOS 歡迎來我的 GitHub 點個 Star、提交 Issue,但不接受PR,任何的PR我都会驳回

projects.summary: Tidytalk 是我开发的一款 Mac 语音输入工具。按住 Option + Command 说一段话，松开后，它在本机识别语音，用 AI 去掉"嗯、那个、就是说"，修正口误、补全标点，再把文字粘贴到光标处。微信、邮件、备忘录、代码编辑器里都能用。 比如说"项目要延期到下周三，不对，是下周四"，粘贴出来的是"项目要延期到下周四。" 它和系统自带的听写不同：不是边说边打字，而是等你说完一整段，整理好再一次性输出，更适合写消息和文档。 隐私是我最在意的部分。语音识别用 SenseVoice 模型，始终在本机完成，录音不上传。AI 整理可以接 Ollama 或 LM Studio 的本机模型，这样整个过程都不联网，也不需要 API Key；想用云端的话，DeepSeek、OpenAI 等兼容接口也都支持。 最新版加了实时字幕：按 ⌃⌥C 收听电脑播放的声音（视频、网课、会议），屏幕底部显示字幕，同样在本机识别；可以逐句翻译，也可以按 ⌃⌥V 把刚才那段话整理后粘贴出来。 Tidytalk 免费，源码以 MIT 协议公开，没有账号和统计。需要 macOS 26 及以上、Apple 芯片的 Mac。安装包还没有经过苹果公证，第一次打开需要在"系统设置 › 隐私与安全性"里点"仍要打开"。 主页：

projects.title: 用 380 行 Python 给公司做了个离线知识库（带出处、带权限）
projects.author: luobobo8965
projects.summary: 公司制度文档散在网盘、群聊、个人电脑，新人问、老人答，答的不一定是现行版本。试过 SaaS 知识库，卡在「数据出内网」和「按人头收费」两点，就自己写了一个。 只做一件事：把 Markdown 丢进 docs/，就能提问，回答带《文档》/章节出处，能点开核对原文；文档带可见范围（普通员工查不到财务制度，财务角色能看到）。全程不联网，零第三方依赖，一个文件 380 行。 几个实现上的小设计： - 分块：维护标题栈 + 段落，约 420 字一块，每块自带「《员工报销制度》/ 报销标准」这样的路径，回答时直接当引用 - 中文分词：二元组切分，不依赖分词库，英文数字按词切 - 召回：BM25 + TF-IDF 双路加权。第一版问「出差住宿报销上限」，第一条返回的是「差旅餐补」——加「查询词覆盖率」加权后才稳定命中住宿段落 - 回答默认抽取式，不生成。制度类问题最怕编造，返回原文让人自己核对 部署就两条命令：`python3 kb.py ingest` 建索引，`python3 kb.py serve` 起服务，目录拷到内网机器就能用。 演示（ 89 秒纯录屏）： https://youtu.be/cNloexteD4s 实现细节长文： https://juejin.cn/spost/7699848140908544010 代码： https://github.com/luobobo896 轻喷。主要想听检索排序和文档权限这两块还有哪些坑，或者你们公司现在怎么解决「制度找不到」这个问题。

projects.title: 两天上线第一个出海 AI 工具站（英文 AI 同人生成器），记录一下过程和踩的坑
projects.author: zkitkevin
projects.summary: 周四晚上定词写需求，周六晚上上线：[fanficwizard.com]( https://fanficwizard.com) 一个英文的 AI 同人（ fanfic ）生成器：填作品、角色/CP 、几个梗（ enemies to lovers 、slow burn 这种）、基调和人称，几秒出一段完整的同人场景，结尾带 AO3 风格的标题和 tags 。免费每天 3 次，不用注册。 ## 为什么做这个 按"一个关键词一个页面"的思路选的词：搜 "ai fanfic generator" 的人意图很明确，就是想要一个工具。前排有大站，也有不少小站，觉得可以试试。这次只上首页，主词站稳了再做内页。 ## 技术 - 自己攒的 Next.js 模板（工具站通用：多字段表单 → 提示词模板 → 流式输出，积分、作品库、后台都是可拆的模块），这次只改配置和文案就出了站 - Next.js 16 + Postgres （ Neon ）+ Prisma + Vercel ，Google 登录，Cloudflare Turnstile 防刷 - 模型走 OpenAI 兼容的网关，分两档：免费用便宜模型写短场景，付费用好模型写整章、能续写（带人物设定 + 前情摘要 + 上一章结尾） - 大部分代码是 Claude Code 写的，我主要做需求、审代码和踩坑 ## 踩的坑 1. **收款**：本来想用 Stripe ，账号资料有点问题，最后改用 MoR （代理销售方，帮你交各国的税、能提现到国内）。顺手比了一下费率：Creem 3.9%+$0.40 ，Waffo 3.9%+$0.50 ，Paddle / Lemon Squeezy 5%+$0.50 。固定费对 $5 的小包很伤，接近 14%，后面准备调价。所以目前定价页还是 Coming soon 。 2. **www 跳转方向选反**：Vercel 加域名时默认勾了"裸域跳 www"，但站点配置、登录回调、canonical 全是裸域，结果生成接口的同源校验和 Google 登录都会挂。改成 www → 裸域 308 就好了。 3. **内容安全**：同人圈对内容很敏感，只写 G/T 级。请求和输出两层检查（输出边流边查），检查服务出错也一律拦截，不扣积分。 4. **免费被刷**：IP 哈希 + Turnstile + 每日全站成本上限，超了就暂停免费额度，不会一觉醒来账单爆了。 ## 想听听大家的意见 - 首页文案和生成效果怎么样？ - 做出海工具站的朋友，收款最后用的哪家？ 随手试一下就行，不用注册。

projects.summary: 平时经常在 GitHub 上找好玩的开源桌面端、开发工具与前沿 AI 项目，但经常遇到几个痛点： 1. 找安装包繁琐：很多优质开源项目没有独立官网，下载时需要点进 Releases 在一堆 source code.zip 和各类架构二进制包中捉迷藏； 2. 官方榜单刷星/题库多：GitHub 官方 Trending 经常被面试八股文、刷星题库霸榜，很难真正发现高可用的实际软件； 3. 架构与平台不清晰：确认是否支持 Mac Apple Silicon 还是 Windows ARM 经常需要费时翻阅 README。 因此开发了 GitHubPlay，致力于做一个专注“应用与客户端分发视角”的开源软件发现平台。 核心功能 多平台安装包一键直达：自动识别分析 Releases 中的多架构安装包（macOS DMG/PKG、Windows EXE/MSI、Linux AppImage/deb），免去繁琐翻找； 多维度真实增长榜：提供 24 小时、7 天、30 天星标增长排行榜，支持按客户端和 AI 工具分类筛选； 深度分类目录：整理了 AI 大模型、开发辅助、效率工具、音视频处理等 30 多个垂直领域； 开源作者专属徽章：开源作者可以直接取用类似动态星标徽章嵌入自己的 README 中； 智能语言自适应：全站基于 Next.js App Router 服务端直出（SSR），智能自适应浏览器语言偏好（中/英双语）。 欢迎阮老师与周刊读者试用交流与批评指正！

projects.title: Show HN: Cryptex Vault – A password manager designed to outlive its creator
projects.author: Bl4cksmith
projects.summary: Hello everyone! About four years ago, a password manager I've used and depended on has been acquired and soon after, it was shut down. If anyone remembers MYKI, it was a password manager that stood out at the time. It didn't require an email address and a password for registration and it synchronized credentials peer-to-peer. It was quite handy so a couple of my friends and I got hooked, and were using it up until the last day it was online. The thing was, I didn't want to change password managers to other options available at the time, none felt right - I wanted to stay.. So I did what any sensible engineer would do 4 years ago and I wrote my own. I moved all my credentials there as soon as I had a first version ready. It was ugly (God knows I had UI/UX skills to learn), but it worked. Soon after, the same friends that were using MYKI switched over to using Cryptex Vault. I get why, we had the same P2P synchronization across devices, it was simple and didn't try to be the most-feature complete application out there - it did the job. That was an exciting moment. So exciting, in fact, that I've posted to HN to tell people about it. At the time, I had a weird thing for decentralization so I called it a "Fully Decentralized Password Manager". Three years go by, I keep maintaining the project, with no real intention of proper marketing or polishing. At one point I checked the usage and figured out that a handful of people (and their families) were still using Cryptex Vault as their password manager. Three months ago, I left my comfy job as lead software engineer at a local company to dedicate time to a company I called Cryptex Industries. Polished Cryptex Vault, cleaned it up, made it open source, started providing Docker images for self-hosting and included some of the features I've only used internally (ssh-agents). That way Cryptex Industries need not remain operational for users to have a path to continued use! To make the project commercially viable, I started offering managed services through the Online Services plan. By using Online Services you remove the operational burden of self-hosting and infrastructure maintenance from yourself while still getting the same benefits: Managed backup storage, synchronization between devices, sharing, ssh-agents, device management. It is convenience, not access to core features. The core application is free and you can use it with no subscriptions of any kind, whatsoever. It's P2P synchronized, with industry-standard crypto choices including post-quantum primitives for synchronization - https://www.cryptex-vault.com/docs/cryptography It has importers for popular password managers, along with autofill for chromium browsers (firefox is a todo, yell and I'll get on it). As for the platforms, there is a web app, an android application and an ssh-agent for linux (will put it up on AUR when they open up registrations again). Feel free to try it out (there is a 14-day trial for managed services!), self-host it or break it. I would appreciate your thoughts on this and I wish you a nice friday!

projects.title: 做了近 10 年合租车主，我开源了自己的订阅账本 Calends
projects.author: enann
projects.summary: 哈喽大家好，我是之前开发 [AppStorePrice]( https://appstoreprice.org/) 的朋友，这次给大家推荐一款订阅管理的开源方案：Calends 。 我自己一直都是订阅记录的重度用户，前前后后用过市面上十多款 App 、开源项目。但是用下来，总觉得它们跟我的实际需求，尤其是合租的场景不太匹配。YouTube 我开车快 10 年了，Spotify 也开了 5 年多。除了记录自己订了什么、花了多少钱，还要记成员付到哪天、哪些钱没收、自己到底垫了多少。再加上跨区、涨价、代付、礼品卡，很多细节都得另外补。 所以这次干脆自己做了一个，把这些年一直想要的功能都做进去。对于我自己的订阅和开车需求，我觉得目前没有比它更合适的了。尤其是现在的 AI 订阅。先放一段视频，大家可以直接看一下整体效果： [观看宣传视频]( https://media.calends.date/launch/2026-10-22/index.html) · [MP4 直链]( https://media.calends.date/launch/2026-10-22/calends-intro.16079708908f.mp4) ![Calends：AI 、合租、代付、多币种和余额续航]( https://media.calends.date/launch/2026-10-22/images/00-launch.8fe81ddc5174.png) ## 我最想说的，还是 AI 和 MCP 现在做软件，我觉得很重要的一点，就是有没有把 Agent 作为一等公民，能不能让 AI 真正帮我把事情做掉。所以在我的这个项目里，基础的 AI 创建、查询、维护订阅这些我都做了，接上自己的 DeepSeek API Key 或兼容服务就能用，收据也可以直接交给它整理，核对后添加。模型调用按你使用的平台计费。 然后是 MCP 。这可以让 Codex 、Claude Code 、Grok Bot 都可以接进来，直接管理自己的订阅账本。我现在的订阅就是交给 Grok Bot 帮我管理的。给了它邮箱权限，再接上 Calends 的 MCP ，每次有新的订阅邮件进来，就让它分析邮件，该新增的新增，该更新的更新，不用我再一条条照着填。 如果你是第一次用，直接让有邮箱权限的 AI 助手去分析历史邮件，把里面的订阅整理出来，查重、核对之后导入就行。如果你之前已经在用其他订阅管理 App ，也可以让能操作手机的 Codex 读取里面的订阅详情，再帮你导入自己的 Calends 。邮箱和手机由你接入的外部助手读取，账本这边通过 MCP 配合它完成录入。 ![Codex 、Claude Code 、Grok Bot 等 AI 助手可以通过 MCP 接入]( https://media.calends.date/launch/2026-10-22/images/02-mcp-clients.cd5cc6dca268.png) ## 还有一些功能，大家看看有没有这些痛点 **我订阅了 iCloud 土耳其区，但是它老涨价，涨价之前的价格怎么记？** 我自己这条 iCloud+，已经从 ₺64.99 涨到 ₺129.99 、₺249.99 ，再到 ₺399.99 。每次涨价的日期、之前多少钱，都能保留下来。切到原币看，也能把涨价和汇率变化分开。 ![我这条 iCloud+ 土耳其区订阅的三次调价记录]( https://media.calends.date/launch/2026-10-22/images/08-subscription-history.c40d149f78b7.png) **Spotify 开了这么多年，我到底总共付出去多少钱，收回来多少钱，亏了还是赚了？** 合租的支出、成员收款、谁付到哪天，都放在一起记。有人按月付，有人一次付半年，也能看清楚还有哪些钱没收到。 **我今天帮朋友续了 ChatGPT ，他上个月的钱付了没有？** 这种就单独记成代付，记到对应的人，收没收、收了多少都能查，也不会把替别人垫的钱算成自己的订阅消费。 **我打折买了礼品卡，面值是这么多，但实际花的钱又不一样，怎么算？** 面值和实际买入成本分开记。卡包里也可以管理支付方式、币种和余额，按后面的扣款估算还能用多久。还有一个很容易忽略的细节：我填的余额到底是哪天的余额？上周查到的数，不能一直当成今天的数，所以余额也专门做了校准日期。 包括汇率，我也专门接了。历史上每次付款，都可以按付款当天的汇率折成人民币，知道那一笔大概花了多少钱。 时间线、续费日历、各种报告图表也都做了。年付的订阅，可以分别看这个月付出去了多少钱、这个月分摊了多少费用；钱花在哪，也可以像看股票热力图那样看每个订阅占了多少。这些看起来都是小功能，但自己长期记订阅、开合租车的时候，确实都会用到，所以我把它们都补上了。 ## 部署和体验 可以直接用 Docker ，放到自己的服务器、NAS 上；也可以用 Cloudflare 账号部署到 Workers + D1 ，个人用量在免费额度内就能免费运行。支持备份恢复和 CSV 导入导出。 - 官网： https://calends.date - 文档： https://docs.calends.date - Demo： https://demo.calends.date - GitHub： https://github.com/imetn/calends 最后，我还专门做了一个彩蛋。**Claude 封号这个事情，我到底被封了几个号？有没有退款？没退的话，到底损失了多少钱？** 这些也可以记。我专门做了一个 [Claude 演示站]( https://demo.calends.date/claude/)，把账号停止、退款、没用完的时长和损失都放进去，大家可以直接进去看。演示站用的是虚构数据，主要给大家演示一下这种被封号的账怎么记。 其实我直接建议，这些事情全都交给 AI 就好了，让他帮我记录好我自己的订阅账，而且我测试下来，自己反代出来的 Deepseek 模型已经完全足够了，本身多模态也支持。粘贴上传图片记录订阅也是一个非常棒的体验。 一不小心说了这么多，总之吧，我觉得大家感兴趣可以去演示站试用一下看看，不关你是上百辆合租的车主，还是中转站几百个 Claude 账号的老板，都可以看看当前的方案能不能满足你的需求好好 项目是 MIT 开源的。如果有些场景还满足不了你的需求，欢迎直接提 [Issue]( https://github.com/imetn/calends/issues)，也欢迎 PR 。如果你自己想做深度定制，直接 fork ，搭自己的订阅账本就好。 如果你觉得这个项目有帮助，不妨在 GitHub 帮我点一个 Star ，这对我来说会非常有帮助。谢谢大家！

projects.title: Show HN: Is there a YC advantage for sales?
projects.author: 30minAdayHN
projects.summary: Hi all, I had a hypothesis that YC companies sell to other YC companies. Many times to their own batch, other times to older YC companies. One of my YC friends told me that when they approached a big, well-known company for a potential pilot, the director of engineering there was a YC alum. He said "yeah, I understand" and gave them a pilot or LOI. My theory is that most of the logos YC startups show on their landing pages will be other YC companies. They'll use that momentum at Demo Day to raise their seed round. What this also means is that sometimes, when I read Launch HNs or look at other YC products, I get the perception that they're very mature products (kudos to their design), and often that perception comes from the logos. So as someone looking to buy a YC product, I'm not sure if I'm being hustled or if they actually have a good customer base. I'm not judging them. This is genuine curiosity, and also, this is what the YC advantage means. I set out to test my hypothesis by running my agents against YC's Summer 2026 batch: visit each landing page, look for customer logos, and check what percent of those are YC companies. What do I get out of this? Probably nothing :p Just curious. Here's a quick summary: - My hypothesis that most logos will be other YC companies is wrong. - In certain sub segments like horizontal AI tools, I did see that ~40% logos are YC companies. Check the link for the analysis. Curious what your thoughts are? Any other directions we can push the analysis into? [This post is handwritten by me]

projects.title: 【开源自荐】futu_algo：基于富途 OpenAPI 的港股量化交易系统，回测和模拟盘逐笔一致
projects.author: billpwchan

github.name: billpwchan/futu_algo
github.description: Futu Algorithmic Trading Solution (Python) 基於富途OpenAPI所開發量化交易程序

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源的港股量化交易系统，futualgo，基于富途 OpenAPI。 项目 2020 年写的，攒了 600 多个 star。今年翻出来一看，新装的环境根本跑不起来（futu-api 删了 OpenHKTradeContext），实盘遇到第一个卖出信号就崩，持仓平不掉，有个策略因为拿一根 K 线跟它自己比，永远不会交易。所以干脆整个重写了，刚发了 2.1.0。 现在的版本： K 线本地缓存，自动翻过富途单页 1000 根的限制，不超频率和历史额度；任意分钟周期按交易时段合成，不跨午休。 指标按通达信的算法实现，公式可以逐行搬过来；每次回测自动检查未来函数。 回测按下一根开盘价、整手成交，印花税和交易征费按成交当天适用的费率算，滑点按港交所价位表，基准是恒生指数。 模拟盘吃 OpenD 实时推送的 K 线，跟回测用同一份策略代码。测试会拿真实的一分钟 K 线同时跑回测和实盘引擎，要求每一笔成交、每一笔费用和最终资金完全一致。 自带网页控制台，不需要富途账户也能用 futu-algo web --demo 在模拟行情里体验。 Python 3.11+，Apache-2.0。

projects.author: healthyhome36
projects.summary: 先说清楚：这是我自己的站，来求反馈的，不是来搬链接的。 背景：美国那边业主弄车库地面、门廊、车道，最常搜的是 "concrete cost per yard" 这类词。但搜出来基本两种——大站给一个全国区间，或者本地搅拌 站的营销页。真正让人卡住的其实不是单价，是短量费、运距加价，以及"到底 要几方"。 所以我做了个工具，分两块： - 用量计算：按尺寸厚度算方量，支持多块区域 - 造价估算：按都会区给单价区间，把短量费、运距、人工拆开算 网址： https://concretepricecalculator.com/ 现在有三处卡住了，想听听各位的意见： 1. 造价这类数字，怎么让它不像编的 我用 BLS 的都会区建筑工种工资加各州搅拌站公开报价去推，但本质上还是 推导值。你们做类似工具时，会在页面上明确写"这是估算区间"吗？还是干脆 规避掉不给具体数字？ 2. 用户要的是总价还是单价 GSC 里 "cost per yard" 的搜索量远大于 "total cost"，但落地页上点进计算 器真算完的比例，反而是总价那条路径高。这种情况该主推哪个？ 3. 地区颗粒度 现在按都会区，再细就到邮编了。做太细数据撑不住，做太粗用户觉得不准。 你们一般停在哪个粒度？ 另外想请教做过美国 YMYL 类目（涉及钱、健康）的朋友，内容可信度这块 （作者信息、数据出处、更新日期）做到什么程度算够？ 有真在美国浇过混凝土的也欢迎指正，尤其短量费和运距那部分是不是这样。

projects.summary: 大模型和智能体让研究者从想法到实验快了很多，投稿量随之增长。投稿前最后一步是学术诚信核对：文献是否真实，引用是否引对，有没有错别字，这一步仍靠手工。Clover 用 AI把已自动化。 Clover 是 macOS 桌面应用，面向准备投稿的研究生和青年学者。拖入一篇英文 docx 论文，即可完成投稿前的整套核对。创新点是识别引错的文献：读取被引文献的摘要和开放全文，判断它是否真的支持正文中这句话，找出张冠李戴和只部分支持引用，并附原文证据。证据必须逐字可查，查不到就标为无法判断。同时到 Crossref、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar 和 arXiv 核对文献是否真实、信息是否一致，检查错别字、未引用文献和引用堆砌，并可对照目标会议论文给出定位。结果一键导出为Word，问题写成批注，错别字写成修订。全文在本机解析，一次检查约 0.19元。体验：jackielyu.is-a.dev/clover，源码：github.com/may3rr/clover。

projects.title: Show HN: Koody for Business – AI bookkeeping for people who aren't accountants
projects.author: Halimah
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Hallie, founder of Koody. Today, I'm launching Koody for Business: AI-powered accounting, bookkeeping, and tax prep software for sole proprietors and small businesses. For years, I used accounting software for my business. I went into it to create invoices, categorize and reconcile transactions, and work with my accountant to prepare our books. I often dreaded having to do it. There were so many transactions to get through in a handful of different currencies, and I found the whole process draining. The software I used (and refuse to name) worked really well. It was capable accounting software, and I'm not trying to suggest otherwise. But for me, accounting had become a bit like going to the dentist. You know it's necessary and useful, but that doesn't stop you from feeling anxious about it or wishing you didn't have to go. What makes this personal is that I've always been good at accounting. Throughout secondary school, I was the best student in every financial accounting class. I was also the class prefect, so I would regularly collect everyone's homework and take it to the staff room for submission. My accounting teacher used to ask me to put mine on top because she used it as a marking guide. I then went on to study finance in undergrad and eventually earned an MBA. So accounting isn't an unfamiliar subject to me, yet dealing with my own books made me extremely sad and anxious. I'm building Koody for Business because I want business owners to see accounting through my original lens: something simple and enjoyable that doesn't require a degree to understand. Koody automatically categorizes business income and expenses and uses those transactions to produce cash flow insights, profit and loss reports, and records for Schedule C and tax prep. There are two workspaces: personal and business. The business workspace lets you manage your business finances separately from your personal finances, even when you use the same bank account for both, as many sole proprietors do. You can keep each transaction in the appropriate workspace, so personal spending stays out of your business reports. You can use Koody just for your business, just for your personal finances, or for both. Give Koody for Business a try at koody.com/business. I'd love to hear what you think.

projects.summary: 这是一个用 Python 写的美股日线信号研究工具：用标普 500、纳斯达克 100 成分股的历史数据构建特征和标签，用带清除间隔和隔离期的 walk-forward 方式训练 LightGBM 模型，再基于样本外预测做评估、回测和报告。适合想系统学习"量化回测怎么避免偷看未来"的开发者。 亮点 防泄漏写进了测试：追加未来数据后历史特征和事件不能变、标签不含信号当天、清除间隔覆盖标签周期、Pivot 回测必须在信号次日入场，uv run pytest -q 就能跑。 信号绝不按产生它的那个收盘价成交（Pivot 次日开盘、AlphaRank 次日收盘），买卖各扣 10 个基点成本，同一天既碰到止盈又碰到止损时按先止损处理。 局限写在明处：历史成分股名单不完整、已退市公司大多缺失，价格大多不含分红，回测里有几处偏乐观的成交简化，文档里逐条列出。 研究与生产分离：训练只产出候选模型，必须人工批准才能上线，不会自动替换。 文档完整：数据格式、特征与标签、训练、评估回测、局限性各有一篇说明。 首个 release： 说明：项目输出仅用于研究和工程验证，不构成投资建议。行情数据与模型文件不在 Apache-2.0 代码许可范围内。
